bead.title: Add current_position and read-as-of-position API
bead.description:
PROBLEM
There is no way to read a consistent projection state at a historical position — needed for consistent external reads that never touch the hot claim path, and to compare a branched queue against its parent at the fork point (TD-009).

CURRENT STATE
- LogStore::high_water gives the current position cheaply (crates/pqueue-engine/src/compose.rs:113).
- Snapshot-at-position storage exists: write_snapshot/latest_snapshot/read_snapshot (compose.rs:116-123).
- No read_as_of exists; the relational family cannot reconstruct prior state at all today ("nothing to replay", crates/pqueue-postgres/src/relational.rs:983-987) until the ADR-013 migration.

PROPOSED FIX
Per TD-009 section 2: add current_position(shard) -> CommandPosition (thin wrapper over high_water) and read_as_of(shard, position, query) that hydrates from the nearest snapshot <= P, replays read_from up to P into an ephemeral projection, answers the bounded query, and discards. Relational backends return a structured capability-unavailable error until rebuildable-from-log.

NON-SCOPE
- Branch (separate bead). Relational rebuild-from-log migration (ADR-013 derived work).
- No always-on secondary projection; the as-of projection is ephemeral per call.
bead.acceptance:
1. read_as_of_reconstructs_prior_state: on the in-memory and object-log backends, a read at position P returns state matching what a live read returned when P was the head, ignoring later commits. cargo test -p pqueue-engine read_as_of_reconstructs_prior_state
2. read_as_of_unavailable_relational: relational backends return the structured capability-unavailable error. cargo test -p pqueue-postgres read_as_of_unavailable_relational
3. cargo test -p pqueue-engine passes.
